name: fetch_image
description: Fetch an image from any public HTTPS host to a local path (private/internal IPs blocked, images only, size-capped)

output.description: Absolute path to the downloaded image file

params.name: url
params.description: HTTPS URL of the image to fetch (any public host; private/internal IPs are blocked)

params.name: out
params.description: Output file path for the downloaded image

params.name: max-bytes
params.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes (default: 25 MiB)
